```python
import requests
import json

requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings()

INDEXER = "https://127.0.0.1:9200"
IDXR = ("admin", "SecretPassword")

# Search for brute force related alerts in the last 7 days
body = {
    "size": 50,
    "query": {
        "bool": {
            "must": [
                {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-7d"}}},
                {
                    "bool": {
                        "should": [
                            {"match": {"rule.groups": "brute_force"}},
                            {"match": {"rule.groups": "authentication_failed"}},
                            {"match": {"rule.description": "brute force"}},
                            {"match": {"rule.description": "SSH brute"}},
                            {"match": {"rule.description": "authentication failure"}},
                            {"match_phrase": {"rule.description": "multiple authentication failures"}},
                            {"match": {"rule.mitre.id": "T1110"}}
                        ],
                        "minimum_should_match": 1
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    },
    "sort": [{"@timestamp": "desc"}],
    "_source": ["@timestamp", "rule.id", "rule.level", "rule.description", "rule.groups", "rule.mitre.id", "agent.name", "agent.id", "data.srcip", "data.dstip", "data.srcuser", "data.dstuser", "location", "full_log"]
}

try:
    r = requests.post(f"{INDEXER}/wazuh-alerts-*/_search",
                      headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      auth=IDXR, verify=False, data=json.dumps(body))
    r.raise_for_status()
    result = r.json()
    hits = result.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])
    total = result.get("hits", {}).get("total", {}).get("value", 0)
    
    print(f"=== BRUTE FORCE ALERTS (last 7 days) ===")
    print(f"Total matching alerts: {total}")
    print(f"Returned: {len(hits)}")
    print()
    
    # Aggregate by source IP
    srcip_counts = {}
    rule_counts = {}
    agent_counts = {}
    
    for hit in hits:
        src = hit["_source"]
        srcip = src.get("data", {}).get("srcip", "N/A")
        rule_desc = src.get("rule", {}).get("description", "N/A")
        rule_id = src.get("rule", {}).get("id", "N/A")
        agent = src.get("agent", {}).get("name", "N/A")
        timestamp = src.get("@timestamp", "N/A")
        level = src.get("rule", {}).get("level", "N/A")
        dstuser = src.get("data", {}).get("dstuser", "N/A")
        srcuser = src.get("data", {}).get("srcuser", "N/A")
        
        srcip_counts[srcip] = srcip_counts.get(srcip, 0) + 1
        rule_counts[rule_desc] = rule_counts.get(rule_desc, 0) + 1
        agent_counts[agent] = agent_counts.get(agent, 0) + 1
        
        print(f"  [{timestamp}] Rule {rule_id} (level {level}): {rule_desc}")
        print(f"    Agent: {agent} | SrcIP: {srcip} | DstUser: {dstuser} | SrcUser: {srcuser}")
        print()
    
    print("=== TOP SOURCE IPs ===")
    for ip, count in sorted(srcip_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]:
        print(f"  {ip}: {count} alerts")
    
    print("\n=== TOP RULES ===")
    for rule, count in sorted(rule_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]:
        print(f"  {rule}: {count} alerts")
    
    print("\n=== AFFECTED AGENTS ===")
    for agent, count in sorted(agent_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
        print(f"  {agent}: {count} alerts")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
```
